title: [ARKNIGHTS X RILAKKUMA] LANGUID SENTIMENT COLLAB EVENT OPEN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X RILAKKUMA] LANGUID SENTIMENT COLLAB EVENT OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in to claim rewards, including Event Exclusive Furniture and other materials.
02 [ARKNIGHTS X RILAKKUMA] PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available in the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Icon 'Friendly Rilakkuma Doll' * 1, Icon 'Sweet Korilakkuma Doll' * 1, Icon 'Brave Leader Rilakkuma Doll' * 1, Icon 'Focused Korilakkuma Doll' * 1, Icon 'Honey Pal Rilakkuma Doll' * 1
◆ This Profile Theme can be switched among different Operators: Rosa, Ifrit, Gummy, Zima, Istina, and Leto .
03 [ARKNIGHTS X RILAKKUMA] COLLAB OUTFITS NOW AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
CROSSOVER Collection - Forever Together for Rosa
CROSSOVER Collection - Relaxing Trip for Ifrit
[Outfit Voucher] cannot be used to redeem the collab Outfits.
Please stay tuned for more information!
